relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: This OIH associated with CIPN is inhibited by interventions that reverse Type II priming [the combination of an inhibitor of Src and mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK)], an MOR antagonist, as well as a TLR4 antagonist.

key_findings: Nociceptor MOR antisense prevents and reverses oxaliplatin- and paclitaxel-induced hyperalgesia and attenuates priming in rats.
Intradermal morphine exacerbates hyperalgesia in CIPN rats (OIH), inhibited by MOR or TLR4 antagonists.
